taxonomy_note: Analyst planning lens; reassess actual root cause.

controls.source_trace: Open XPath expression construction, namespace setup, variable bindings and the XML document/query consumer. Distinguish query construction from parser entity resolution.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a tiny local XML fixture with public and private synthetic nodes. Compare a literal account/search value with the suspected expression input and inspect which nodes the evaluator selects. Follow later string interpolation even if the original XML storage was safe.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An XML parse error or entity-resolution issue is not XPath injection. Quoting characters in input prove nothing if the value is bound as a variable in the actual evaluator.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind supported XPath variables or select from trusted expression structures and handle namespaces explicitly. Retest legitimate punctuation and the exact unauthorized node-selection case.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
